content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Ropar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Ropar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) for project-based research and technical positions in Rupnagar, Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced across multiple posts including Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Field Assistant, and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications is 20-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech/M.E. in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, High Voltage Engineering, or a relevant area with a minimum CPI of 6.5 or 60% marks along with a valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of 37,000 plus HRA as per institutional norms.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Field and Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Field Assistant and Project Assistant roles must hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIT Ropar posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the designated Google form and complete all required application steps before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by IIT Ropar for these project-based positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the project associated with this job notification?
faq.answer: These positions are tied to the specific research and development project titled 'Research and Development of Location and Quantification of Partial Discharges in Power Cables'.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the direct link to apply online?
faq.answer: The direct application link and the official Google form link are provided in the Important Links section of this notification article.
